description: Conversion of first floor caretaker's flat to community office space, with internal refurbishment works including, accessibility improvements, installation of air source heat pumps, new entrance with canopy and paving, new fencing to garden at side and rear, removal of 1 x parking space, bin and cycle storage, new window to north elevation, replacement of external wall and windows to first floor of west elevation, and solar panels to roof.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan 2507-S3-X-000 RevA Dated 02.02.2026Existing Block Plan 2507-S3-X-001 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing Site Plan 2507-S3-X-002 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing Lower Ground Floor Plan 2507-S3-X-100 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing Ground Floor Plan 2507-S3-X-101 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing Upper Floor Plan 2507-S3-X-102 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing Roof Plan 2507-S3-X-103 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing South Site Elevation 2507-S3-X-200 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing South Elevation 2507-S3-X-201 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing North Elevation 2507-S3-X-202 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing East Elevation 2507-S3-X-203 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing West Elevation 2507-S3-X-204 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Existing Long Section 2507-S3-X-300 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Block Plan 2507-S3-P-001 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Site Plan 2507-S3-P-002 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Lower Ground Floor Plan 2507-S3-P-100 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Ground Floor Plan 2507-S3-P-101 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Upper Floor Plan 2507-S3-P-102 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Roof Plan 2507-S3-P-103 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Site Elevation (South) 2507-S3-P-200 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed South Elevation 2507-S3-P-201 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed North Elevation 2507-S3-P-202 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed East Elevation 2507-S3-P-203 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed West Elevation 2507-S3-P-204 RevA Dated 27.01.2026Proposed Long Section 2507-S3-P-300 RevA Dated 27.01.2026HIGHWAY SAFETY IMPACT FORMDESIGN AND ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENTReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to first use of the community office space hereby permitted, the cycle parking facilities shown on the approved plans shall be provided and thereafter retained for use as cycle parking only.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

Noise from any external plant, machinery or equipment shall not exceed the existing background noise level LA90,15min, when measured at the facade of the nearest noise-sensitive premises, at any time of operation.Reason: To protect the amenity of surrounding occupiers and the area from noise.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

No plant or equipment shall be affixed to any external face of a building or added to the roof of a building other than that shown in the approved drawings.Reason: In the interest of amenity and to ensure a satisfactory external appearance in accordance with policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Policy (2014).

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), the first-floor office accommodation hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes falling within Use Class F2 (Local Community Uses) and for no other purpose without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure the premises remain available for local community use and to prevent the loss of community facilities to alternative uses, in the interests of supporting inclusive and sustainable communities.

The external plant condensers hereby approved shall be supported on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts as necessary to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the occupiers of nearby residential properties.
